{{Top|leg}}
A '''Class E spacesuit''' was a type of [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]], a life support uniform used to survive in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or otherwise uninhabitable areas. With separate [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] supplies, the rated duration of [[Extra Vehicular Activity]] for a Class D spacesuit was indefinite duration. The [[Armor/Legends|armors]] worn by the [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s were Class E spacesuits.
